query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

titleDescription.title: 三情景：买入后隐含年化收益率 vs 要求收益率（%）

query.sql: SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

titleDescription.title: 买入价 → 隐含年化收益率（基准情景，%）

query.sql: SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "要求收益率", s.name AS "情景", round(vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.r)::numeric, 2) AS "最高买入价", x.r, s.sort FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x UNION ALL SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%', '市场价', round(cc.latest_price::numeric, 2), x.r, 99 FROM vi_model_base m JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x ORDER BY 4, 5

titleDescription.title: 要求收益率 → 最高买入价（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS "今天每股价值" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

titleDescription.title: 三情景·今天每股价值（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, '今天价值' AS item, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS price, v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '低档关注价', round(v.watch_low::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '高档关注价', round(v.watch_high::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '市场价', round(v.market_price::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY sort, item

titleDescription.title: 今天价值、关注价与市场价（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.terminal_share::numeric, 4) AS "终值占比" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

titleDescription.title: 终值占比（越高越依赖远期）

query.sql: SELECT p.year, x.item, round(x.amount::numeric, 1) AS amount FROM vi_projection p JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', p.np_parent), ('计划股息', p.dividend), ('FCFE', p.fcfe)) x(item, amount) WHERE p.is_base ORDER BY p.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 基准情景：利润、股息与 FCFE（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT round((s.r * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS r, 'g=' || round((s.g * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS g, round(s.value_today::numeric, 2) AS value FROM vi_sensitivity s JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY s.r, s.g

titleDescription.title: 敏感性：今天每股价值（元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year

titleDescription.title: 带息负债：历史与预测（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('分红总额', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：归母净利润与分红总额（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：经营现金流与资本开支（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('ROE', h.roe)) x(item, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：毛利率与 ROE（%）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, CASE WHEN h.volume < 100 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year

titleDescription.title: 历史：全球月活跃用户（年末，含手机与平板）（亿人）

query.sql: SELECT s.scenario_name AS "情景", x.k AS "部分", round((x.v / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "元/股", s.id, x.o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('核心业务', s.core_value, 1), ('成熟业务', s.mature_value, 2), ('成长业务', s.growth_value, 3), ('投入期业务', s.invest_value, 4), ('直接估值业务', s.direct_value, 4), ('可用净现金', s.usable_net_cash, 5), ('对外投资（折后）', s.investments, 6), ('独立固定资产', s.fixed_assets, 7), ('其他非经营资产', s.other_assets, 8), ('少数股东与其他', s.minority_other, 9), ('合计', s.equity_value, 10)) x(k, v, o) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.id, x.o

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：每股价值构成（元）

query.sql: SELECT g.name AS "部分", round((g.value / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "元/股", 10 + coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(g.code, '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int, 0) AS o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_sotp_segment_val g ON g.scenario_id = s.id WHERE s.is_base UNION ALL SELECT '核心业务', round((s.core_value / s.shares)::numeric, 2), 1 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE s.is_base AND s.core_value IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT x.k, round((x.v / s.shares)::numeric, 2), x.o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('可用净现金', s.usable_net_cash, 30), ('对外投资（折后）', s.investments, 31), ('独立固定资产', s.fixed_assets, 32), ('其他非经营资产', s.other_assets, 33), ('少数股东与其他', s.minority_other, 34), ('每股价值', s.equity_value, 40), ('市场价', s.market_price * s.shares, 41)) x(k, v, o) WHERE s.is_base AND x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 3

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：基准情景价值构成（元/股，逐项）

query.sql: SELECT x.m AS "倍数", s.scenario_name AS "系列", round(((coalesce(s.core_earnings, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_earn_pv, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_interim_pv, 0) + coalesce(s.growth_value, 0) + coalesce(s.invest_value, 0) + coalesce(s.direct_value, 0) + s.noncore) / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "每股价值", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) UNION ALL SELECT x.m, '市场价', round(s.market_price::numeric, 2), 999 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY 1, 4

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：倍数 → 每股价值（元；核心业务或成熟业务的倍数）

query.sql: SELECT s.scenario_name AS "情景", x.k AS "口径", round(x.v::numeric, 1) AS "倍", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('合理倍数', coalesce(s.multiple, s.mature_multiple)), ('市场隐含倍数', coalesce(s.implied_core_multiple, s.implied_mature_multiple))) x(k, v) ORDER BY s.id, 2

titleDescription.title: 合理倍数 vs 市场隐含倍数（核心业务或成熟业务）

query.sql: SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id

titleDescription.title: 价投适配度（各维度 0—5 分）

query.sql: SELECT m.code AS code, m.title AS name, CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS grp FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY length(m.code), m.code

titleDescription.title: 竞争壁垒：强度与判定

query.sql: SELECT v.code AS code, v.participant || CASE WHEN v.force IS NULL OR v.force = '不适用' THEN '' ELSE '（' || v.force || '）' END AS name, CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(v.effect, '中性') AS grp FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY length(v.code), v.code

titleDescription.title: 产业链与五力：有利还是不利

query.sql: SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('增速', h.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2

titleDescription.title: 竞争对手对比（%）：付费率、毛利率、增速

query.sql: SELECT coalesce(t.status, '未裁决') AS "裁决", count(*) AS n FROM vi_thesis_base t JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = t.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

titleDescription.title: 核心论点：裁决（成立 / 观察 / 存疑 / 证伪）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL AND d.period_end >= vi_today() - interval '3 years' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.line_item

titleDescription.title: 经营数据：单季同比（%）

query.sql: SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result

titleDescription.title: 质量自检结果

query.sql: SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC

titleDescription.title: 重要事实核验状态

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, round((CASE WHEN co.price_fx_metric_id IS NULL THEN o.value ELSE o.value * fx.value END)::numeric, 2) AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.value FROM vi_obs_current x WHERE x.metric_id = co.price_fx_metric_id AND x.obs_date <= o.obs_date ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC LIMIT 1) fx ON true ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：股价（元；境外报价按当日汇率折算）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：中债国债10年收益率（%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('手机×AIoT 分部收入', '智能电动汽车及AI分部收入') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季分部收入（亿元）：手机×AIoT vs 智能电动汽车及 AI

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('生态经营利润（推算）', '汽车及AI分部经营损益') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季经营损益（亿元）：生态（推算）vs 汽车及 AI 分部（含 AI 投入）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "利润率（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '生态经营利润率（推算）' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 生态经营利润率（%）：年度与单季（推算；估值把手机、AIoT、互联网分开，基准正常化合计约 7.9%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "毛利率（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机毛利率', 'IoT毛利率', '互联网服务毛利率', '汽车及AI分部毛利率') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季毛利率（%）：手机、IoT、互联网、汽车及 AI

query.sql: SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '智能手机毛利率' THEN '手机毛利率' WHEN 'IoT毛利率' THEN 'IoT 毛利率' WHEN '互联网服务毛利率' THEN '互联网毛利率' ELSE '生态费用率' END AS "项目", d.value AS "%" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机毛利率', 'IoT毛利率', '互联网服务毛利率', '生态营业费用率（推算）') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 年度毛利率与生态费用率（%）：手机、IoT、互联网（估值正常化：手机 11.8%、AIoT 20%、互联网 76.5%、费用率 14%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '智能手机经营利润（分摊）' THEN '手机' WHEN 'AIoT经营利润（分摊）' THEN 'AIoT' ELSE '互联网' END AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机经营利润（分摊）', 'AIoT经营利润（分摊）', '互联网服务经营利润（分摊）') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 按收入分摊费用后的年度经营利润（亿元）：手机是获客成本，利润来自互联网与 AIoT

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "百万台" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '智能手机出货量' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 智能手机出货（百万台）：存储涨价下“控量保价”

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '智能手机ASP' ORDER BY d.period_end

titleDescription.title: 智能手机 ASP（元）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "辆" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '汽车交付量' AND d.period_kind = '单季' ORDER BY d.period_end

titleDescription.title: 汽车交付（辆）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "百万人" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item IN ('全球月活跃用户（12 月）', '全球月活跃用户') ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 全球月活跃用户（百万人）：年末与季末

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item IN ('现金储备', '借款') AND d.period_end >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 现金储备与借款（亿元，季末）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'HKDCNY' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：港元兑人民币

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

titleDescription.title: 三情景：买入后隐含年化收益率 vs 要求收益率（%）

query.sql: SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

titleDescription.title: 买入价 → 隐含年化收益率（基准情景，%）

query.sql: SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "要求收益率", s.name AS "情景", round(vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.r)::numeric, 2) AS "最高买入价", x.r, s.sort FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x UNION ALL SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%', '市场价', round(cc.latest_price::numeric, 2), x.r, 99 FROM vi_model_base m JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x ORDER BY 4, 5

titleDescription.title: 要求收益率 → 最高买入价（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS "今天每股价值" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

titleDescription.title: 三情景·今天每股价值（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, '今天价值' AS item, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS price, v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '低档关注价', round(v.watch_low::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '高档关注价', round(v.watch_high::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '市场价', round(v.market_price::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY sort, item

titleDescription.title: 今天价值、关注价与市场价（元）

query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.terminal_share::numeric, 4) AS "终值占比" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

titleDescription.title: 终值占比（越高越依赖远期）

query.sql: SELECT p.year, x.item, round(x.amount::numeric, 1) AS amount FROM vi_projection p JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', p.np_parent), ('计划股息', p.dividend), ('FCFE', p.fcfe)) x(item, amount) WHERE p.is_base ORDER BY p.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 基准情景：利润、股息与 FCFE（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT round((s.r * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS r, 'g=' || round((s.g * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS g, round(s.value_today::numeric, 2) AS value FROM vi_sensitivity s JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY s.r, s.g

titleDescription.title: 敏感性：今天每股价值（元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year

titleDescription.title: 带息负债：历史与预测（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('分红总额', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：归母净利润与分红总额（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：经营现金流与资本开支（亿元）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, x.item, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('ROE', h.roe)) x(item, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

titleDescription.title: 历史：毛利率与 ROE（%）

query.sql: SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, CASE WHEN h.volume < 100 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year

titleDescription.title: 历史：全球月活跃用户（年末，含手机与平板）（亿人）

query.sql: SELECT s.scenario_name AS "情景", x.k AS "部分", round((x.v / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "元/股", s.id, x.o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('核心业务', s.core_value, 1), ('成熟业务', s.mature_value, 2), ('成长业务', s.growth_value, 3), ('投入期业务', s.invest_value, 4), ('直接估值业务', s.direct_value, 4), ('可用净现金', s.usable_net_cash, 5), ('对外投资（折后）', s.investments, 6), ('独立固定资产', s.fixed_assets, 7), ('其他非经营资产', s.other_assets, 8), ('少数股东与其他', s.minority_other, 9), ('合计', s.equity_value, 10)) x(k, v, o) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.id, x.o

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：每股价值构成（元）

query.sql: SELECT g.name AS "部分", round((g.value / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "元/股", 10 + coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(g.code, '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int, 0) AS o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_sotp_segment_val g ON g.scenario_id = s.id WHERE s.is_base UNION ALL SELECT '核心业务', round((s.core_value / s.shares)::numeric, 2), 1 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE s.is_base AND s.core_value IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT x.k, round((x.v / s.shares)::numeric, 2), x.o FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('可用净现金', s.usable_net_cash, 30), ('对外投资（折后）', s.investments, 31), ('独立固定资产', s.fixed_assets, 32), ('其他非经营资产', s.other_assets, 33), ('少数股东与其他', s.minority_other, 34), ('每股价值', s.equity_value, 40), ('市场价', s.market_price * s.shares, 41)) x(k, v, o) WHERE s.is_base AND x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 3

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：基准情景价值构成（元/股，逐项）

query.sql: SELECT x.m AS "倍数", s.scenario_name AS "系列", round(((coalesce(s.core_earnings, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_earn_pv, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_interim_pv, 0) + coalesce(s.growth_value, 0) + coalesce(s.invest_value, 0) + coalesce(s.direct_value, 0) + s.noncore) / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "每股价值", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) UNION ALL SELECT x.m, '市场价', round(s.market_price::numeric, 2), 999 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY 1, 4

titleDescription.title: 分部加总：倍数 → 每股价值（元；核心业务或成熟业务的倍数）

query.sql: SELECT s.scenario_name AS "情景", x.k AS "口径", round(x.v::numeric, 1) AS "倍", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('合理倍数', coalesce(s.multiple, s.mature_multiple)), ('市场隐含倍数', coalesce(s.implied_core_multiple, s.implied_mature_multiple))) x(k, v) ORDER BY s.id, 2

titleDescription.title: 合理倍数 vs 市场隐含倍数（核心业务或成熟业务）

query.sql: SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id

titleDescription.title: 价投适配度（各维度 0—5 分）

query.sql: SELECT m.code AS code, m.title AS name, CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS grp FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY length(m.code), m.code

titleDescription.title: 竞争壁垒：强度与判定

query.sql: SELECT v.code AS code, v.participant || CASE WHEN v.force IS NULL OR v.force = '不适用' THEN '' ELSE '（' || v.force || '）' END AS name, CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(v.effect, '中性') AS grp FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' ORDER BY length(v.code), v.code

titleDescription.title: 产业链与五力：有利还是不利

query.sql: SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('增速', h.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2

titleDescription.title: 竞争对手对比（%）：付费率、毛利率、增速

query.sql: SELECT coalesce(t.status, '未裁决') AS "裁决", count(*) AS n FROM vi_thesis_base t JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = t.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

titleDescription.title: 核心论点：裁决（成立 / 观察 / 存疑 / 证伪）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL AND d.period_end >= vi_today() - interval '3 years' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.line_item

titleDescription.title: 经营数据：单季同比（%）

query.sql: SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result

titleDescription.title: 质量自检结果

query.sql: SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC

titleDescription.title: 重要事实核验状态

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, round((CASE WHEN co.price_fx_metric_id IS NULL THEN o.value ELSE o.value * fx.value END)::numeric, 2) AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.value FROM vi_obs_current x WHERE x.metric_id = co.price_fx_metric_id AND x.obs_date <= o.obs_date ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC LIMIT 1) fx ON true ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：股价（元；境外报价按当日汇率折算）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：中债国债10年收益率（%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('手机×AIoT 分部收入', '智能电动汽车及AI分部收入') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季分部收入（亿元）：手机×AIoT vs 智能电动汽车及 AI

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('生态经营利润（推算）', '汽车及AI分部经营损益') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季经营损益（亿元）：生态（推算）vs 汽车及 AI 分部（含 AI 投入）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "利润率（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '生态经营利润率（推算）' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 生态经营利润率（%）：年度与单季（推算；估值把手机、AIoT、互联网分开，基准正常化合计约 7.9%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "毛利率（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机毛利率', 'IoT毛利率', '互联网服务毛利率', '汽车及AI分部毛利率') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 单季毛利率（%）：手机、IoT、互联网、汽车及 AI

query.sql: SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '智能手机毛利率' THEN '手机毛利率' WHEN 'IoT毛利率' THEN 'IoT 毛利率' WHEN '互联网服务毛利率' THEN '互联网毛利率' ELSE '生态费用率' END AS "项目", d.value AS "%" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机毛利率', 'IoT毛利率', '互联网服务毛利率', '生态营业费用率（推算）') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 年度毛利率与生态费用率（%）：手机、IoT、互联网（估值正常化：手机 11.8%、AIoT 20%、互联网 76.5%、费用率 14%）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '智能手机经营利润（分摊）' THEN '手机' WHEN 'AIoT经营利润（分摊）' THEN 'AIoT' ELSE '互联网' END AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.line_item IN ('智能手机经营利润（分摊）', 'AIoT经营利润（分摊）', '互联网服务经营利润（分摊）') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 按收入分摊费用后的年度经营利润（亿元）：手机是获客成本，利润来自互联网与 AIoT

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "百万台" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '智能手机出货量' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 智能手机出货（百万台）：存储涨价下“控量保价”

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '智能手机ASP' ORDER BY d.period_end

titleDescription.title: 智能手机 ASP（元）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "辆" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '汽车交付量' AND d.period_kind = '单季' ORDER BY d.period_end

titleDescription.title: 汽车交付（辆）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.value AS "百万人" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item IN ('全球月活跃用户（12 月）', '全球月活跃用户') ORDER BY d.period_end, d.period_kind

titleDescription.title: 全球月活跃用户（百万人）：年末与季末

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' WHERE d.line_item IN ('现金储备', '借款') AND d.period_end >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

titleDescription.title: 现金储备与借款（亿元，季末）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'HKDCNY' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：港元兑人民币
